name: routogram-monorepo
description: Codebase architectural topology and navigation engine for modern web projects.

scripts.dev: pnpm build:types && pnpm build:native:debug && pnpm build:cloud && pnpm build:client && node scripts/dev.mjs
scripts.build: pnpm build:native && pnpm build:types && pnpm build:cloud && pnpm build:plugins && pnpm build:client && pnpm build:cli && pnpm build:extension && pnpm build:canvas && node scripts/build-report-template.mjs && pnpm build:lsp
scripts.build:lsp: cargo build --release --bin routogram-lsp --no-default-features --features lsp-cli && node scripts/copy-lsp.mjs
scripts.build:desktop: pnpm build && node scripts/bundle-desktop-daemon.mjs && cargo build --release --manifest-path crates/routogram-desktop/Cargo.toml
scripts.typecheck: pnpm build:types && pnpm build:cloud && pnpm build:plugins && pnpm -r --filter "./packages/**" exec tsc --noEmit
scripts.verify: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
scripts.postinstall: pnpm build:types && pnpm build:cloud && pnpm build:plugins
scripts.build:plugins: pnpm --filter @routogram/plugin-core build && pnpm --filter @routogram/plugin-react build && pnpm --filter @routogram/plugin-next build && pnpm --filter @routogram/plugin-vue build
